overview_description.description:
Paymob is a regional digital payments enabler that builds payments infrastructue technologies empowering the underserved with access to financial services. Paymob is bridging the financial inclusion gap in MEA region by enabling businesses of all sizes to benefit from the power of digital payments and what it unlocks. 

Paymob was founded in 2015 and headquartered in Cairo, Egypt.

about_short_description.short_description: Paymob is a digital payments enabler for emerging markets, helping small and large enterprises accept payments online and in-store.

product.name: Online Payment
product.description: A service to accept online payments instantly using various secured payment methods for e-commerce and digital businesses.

product.name: POS Solution
product.description: An integrated point-of-sale device and system that enables in-store payment acceptance through multiple payment methods including cards, wallets, and installments.

product.name: Payouts
product.description: A service to manage and distribute mass payments securely to suppliers, employees, or beneficiaries via various regulated payment methods.

product.name: Paymob Sync
product.description: An end-to-end cashless payment solution providing technology, infrastructure, processes, and hardware to enable cashless ecosystems in communities and institutions.

product.name: Digital Wallet
product.description: A white-label digital wallet infrastructure enabling businesses to create secure electronic wallets for customers to make and receive payments digitally.

product.name: Installments
product.description: A payment system that allows customers to pay for purchases in installments over periods up to 36 months, with options for 0% interest financing.
